concept: A Sentinel Grove review report that lists each finding with its severity, root cause and recommended fix, shown as a clean structured report card.
scene: Flat brand card on a deep navy background. A simplified report sheet sits at center-right with three stacked rows, each with a small amber marker beside a short line, suggesting severity, root cause and fix. A thin amber rule runs beneath the overlay text on the left. No people, no code, no badges, no logos beyond a minimal grove-inspired mark.
overlay_text: each finding with its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
alt_text: Navy card with a simplified report sheet showing three rows, each with an amber marker, beside the text: each finding with its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.
